:::{#exr-matrix-transpose-practice}
#### Transposing a $3 \times 2$ matrix

The [transpose](#def-matrix-transpose) turns the [row](#def-matrix-row)s of a [matrix](#def-matrix) into [column](#def-matrix-column)s,
just as the [transpose of a vector](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-transpose) turns a column into a row.
Let

$$
\matr{B} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Compute $\tp{\matr{B}}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Entry $(i, j)$ of the [transpose](#def-matrix-transpose) is entry $(j, i)$ of the original [matrix](#def-matrix),
as in @exm-matrix-transpose.

:::
